average-time-resolve-tickets-past-year-p.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created)) / 3600) AS 'Average Resolution Delay (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'resolved' AND tickets.date_created = %PAST_YEAR%
GROUP BY tickets.department
average-time-resolve-tickets-past-year-p.title: Average time to resolve tickets per [department] (past year)

most-active-unresolved-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets_messages.ticket.date_created, COUNT(tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1 AND tickets_messages.is_agent_note = 0) AS 'Total Agent Replies', COUNT(tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 0) AS 'Total User Replies'
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.ticket.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
GROUP BY tickets_messages.ticket
ORDER BY @'Total Agent Replies' DESC
LIMIT 100;
most-active-unresolved-tickets.title: Most active unresolved tickets

percentage-tickets-resolved-24-hours.query:

FROM tickets

tickets-awaiting-agent-grouped-by-agent-.description: This report lists the number of tickets awaiting an agent response for each agent, grouped by the number of days the user has been waiting.
tickets-awaiting-agent-grouped-by-agent-.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
SPLIT BY tickets.agent
GROUP BY FLOOR((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_user_waiting)) / 86400)
tickets-awaiting-agent-grouped-by-agent-.title: Tickets awaiting agent grouped by [agent and time waiting]

users-most-time-waiting-ticket-first-rep.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / 60 * 60 AS 'Total Wait (Hours)', COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets', AVG(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / 60 * 60 AS 'Average Wait (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %PAST_YEAR%
GROUP BY tickets.person
ORDER BY SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) DESC
LIMIT 100
users-most-time-waiting-ticket-first-rep.title: Users with most time waiting for first reply (past year)
